ngsl12:the.exampleEnglish: I found a wallet outside the library and handed the wallet to a member of staff.
ngsl12:the.exampleChinese: 我在图书馆外发现一个钱包，把它交给了一名工作人员。

ngsl12:be.exampleEnglish: The old library will be a community centre once the building work has finally been completed.
ngsl12:be.exampleChinese: 旧图书馆在施工全部完成后将成为一个社区中心。

ngsl12:and.exampleEnglish: The museum offers guided tours and practical workshops, so visitors can learn in several different ways.
ngsl12:and.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供导览和实践工作坊，让游客能用几种不同方式学习。

ngsl12:of.exampleEnglish: The roof of the old station was damaged, so passengers had to use another entrance.
ngsl12:of.exampleChinese: 老车站的屋顶受损，因此乘客不得不使用另一个入口。

ngsl12:to.exampleEnglish: We walked to the harbour after dinner because my sister wanted to photograph the fishing boats.
ngsl12:to.exampleChinese: 晚饭后我们步行去港口，因为姐姐想拍摄渔船。

ngsl12:a.exampleEnglish: During the journey, a passenger offered me a seat when she noticed my heavy bag.
ngsl12:a.exampleChinese: 旅途中，一位乘客注意到我沉重的包，便给我让了座。

ngsl12:in.exampleEnglish: The documents were still in my backpack, although I thought I had left them at home.
ngsl12:in.exampleChinese: 文件仍在我的背包里，尽管我以为自己把它们落在家里了。

ngsl12:have.exampleEnglish: We have a spare room upstairs, so my cousin can stay whenever she visits the city.
ngsl12:have.exampleChinese: 我们楼上有一间空房，所以表妹来这座城市时随时可以住下。

ngsl12:it.exampleEnglish: I bought a second-hand bicycle last month, and it has made my journey to work much easier.
ngsl12:it.exampleChinese: 我上个月买了一辆二手自行车，它让我的上班路程轻松多了。

ngsl12:you.exampleEnglish: If you explain the problem clearly, the support team will be able to help more quickly.
ngsl12:you.exampleChinese: 如果你清楚地说明问题，支持团队就能更快地提供帮助。

ngsl12:he.exampleEnglish: My brother wanted to become a chef, so he started helping in a restaurant after school.
ngsl12:he.exampleChinese: 我弟弟想当厨师，所以放学后开始在一家餐馆帮忙。

ngsl12:for.exampleEnglish: We bought a small tent for our weekend trip, hoping the weather would stay dry.
ngsl12:for.exampleChinese: 我们为周末旅行买了一顶小帐篷，希望天气保持晴朗。

ngsl12:they.exampleEnglish: The volunteers arrived before sunrise because they needed enough time to prepare the outdoor stage.
ngsl12:they.exampleChinese: 志愿者们日出前就到了，因为他们需要足够时间准备户外舞台。

ngsl12:not.exampleEnglish: The tickets are not refundable, so please check the travel dates carefully before you book.
ngsl12:not.exampleChinese: 这些票不能退款，因此预订前请仔细核对出行日期。

ngsl12:that.exampleEnglish: Several boxes looked similar, but that was the one containing the photographs we had been searching for.
ngsl12:that.exampleChinese: 几个箱子看起来很像，但那个才装着我们一直寻找的照片。

ngsl12:we.exampleEnglish: Although the route was longer than expected, we reached the village before the last bus left.
ngsl12:we.exampleChinese: 虽然路线比预期长，但我们在末班车离开前到达了村子。

ngsl12:on.exampleEnglish: Please leave the parcel on the kitchen table, where my neighbour will find it this evening.
ngsl12:on.exampleChinese: 请把包裹放在厨房桌子上，我邻居今晚会在那里找到它。

ngsl12:with.exampleEnglish: I travelled with two colleagues who knew the area well and suggested several interesting places to visit.
ngsl12:with.exampleChinese: 我和两位熟悉当地的同事同行，他们推荐了几个有趣的游览地点。

ngsl12:this.exampleEnglish: I have compared several routes, and this is the one that gives us the best coastal views.
ngsl12:this.exampleChinese: 我比较了几条路线，这条能让我们欣赏到最好的海岸景色。

ngsl12:i.exampleEnglish: Although I had never repaired a bicycle before, I managed to replace the broken chain myself.
ngsl12:i.exampleChinese: 虽然我以前从没修过自行车，但还是设法自己更换了断掉的链条。

ngsl12:do.exampleEnglish: We should do the most difficult tasks first, while everyone still has plenty of energy.
ngsl12:do.exampleChinese: 我们应该先做最难的任务，趁大家精力还很充沛。

ngsl12:as.exampleEnglish: The replacement battery lasts as long as the original, although it costs considerably less to buy.
ngsl12:as.exampleChinese: 替换电池的续航和原装一样长，购买价格却低很多。

ngsl12:at.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet at the main entrance because the exhibition centre has several smaller doors.
ngsl12:at.exampleChinese: 我们约定在正门见面，因为展览中心还有几个较小的门。

ngsl12:she.exampleEnglish: Our neighbour grows vegetables on her balcony, and she often shares the extra tomatoes with us.
ngsl12:she.exampleChinese: 邻居在阳台种菜，她经常把多余的番茄分给我们。

ngsl12:but.exampleEnglish: The apartment is smaller than we expected, but its large windows make every room feel bright.
ngsl12:but.exampleChinese: 这套公寓比我们预期的小，但大窗户让每个房间都很明亮。

ngsl12:from.exampleEnglish: The walking route begins from the old bridge and continues along the river towards the forest.
ngsl12:from.exampleChinese: 这条步行路线从老桥开始，沿河一直通往森林方向。

collocations.chinese: 从一个地方到另一个地方

ngsl12:by.exampleEnglish: We waited by the ticket office, where a member of staff explained why the train was delayed.
ngsl12:by.exampleChinese: 我们在售票处旁等候，一名工作人员在那里解释了火车晚点的原因。

ngsl12:will.exampleEnglish: The new sports centre will open next spring, provided that the final building checks go well.
ngsl12:will.exampleChinese: 如果最后的建筑检查顺利，新体育中心将于明年春天开放。

ngsl12:or.exampleEnglish: You can submit the form online or bring a printed copy to the office before Friday.
ngsl12:or.exampleChinese: 你可以在周五之前在线提交表格，或把打印件带到办公室。

ngsl12:say.exampleEnglish: Please say what you really think about the design, because we still have time to improve it.
ngsl12:say.exampleChinese: 请说出你对设计的真实看法，因为我们还有时间改进。

ngsl12:go.exampleEnglish: We decided to go to the smaller museum, which had an excellent exhibition about local history.
ngsl12:go.exampleChinese: 我们决定去那家较小的博物馆，那里有很精彩的地方历史展。

ngsl12:so.exampleEnglish: The road through the mountains was closed, so our driver had to find a different route.
ngsl12:so.exampleChinese: 穿山公路封闭了，所以司机不得不另找一条路线。

ngsl12:all.exampleEnglish: By the time the guests arrived, the children were all dressed and ready for the celebration.
ngsl12:all.exampleChinese: 客人们到达时，孩子们都已穿戴整齐，准备参加庆祝活动。

ngsl12:if.exampleEnglish: If the weather improves by lunchtime, we can finish our picnic and explore the nearby village.
ngsl12:if.exampleChinese: 如果午饭前天气好转，我们就能吃完野餐，再去逛附近的村子。

ngsl12:one.exampleEnglish: Only one seat was available on the earlier train, so we decided to travel together later.
ngsl12:one.exampleChinese: 早一班火车只剩一个座位，所以我们决定晚些一起走。

ngsl12:would.exampleEnglish: Would you mind explaining the instructions again, since several people joined after the meeting had started?
ngsl12:would.exampleChinese: 你介意再解释一次说明吗？因为有几个人在会议开始后才加入。

ngsl12:about.exampleEnglish: The guide told us about the castle's history while we climbed the narrow stairs to the tower.
ngsl12:about.exampleChinese: 我们爬上通往塔楼的狭窄楼梯时，导游给我们讲了城堡的历史。

ngsl12:can.exampleEnglish: With a little practice, you can prepare this meal in less time than it takes to order food.
ngsl12:can.exampleChinese: 稍加练习，你做出这顿饭的时间就能比点外卖还短。

ngsl12:which.exampleEnglish: Which route would you recommend for visitors who want to avoid traffic and enjoy the countryside?
ngsl12:which.exampleChinese: 对于想避开交通拥堵并欣赏乡村风景的游客，你会推荐哪条路线？

ngsl12:there.exampleEnglish: We spent a weekend in the village and discovered that several artists had moved there recently.
ngsl12:there.exampleChinese: 我们在村里度过了一个周末，发现最近有几位艺术家搬到了那里。

ngsl12:know.exampleEnglish: Although I know the main road well, I always check the map before trying a different route.
ngsl12:know.exampleChinese: 虽然我很熟悉主路，但尝试别的路线前总会查地图。

ngsl12:more.exampleEnglish: We need more volunteers for the weekend event because the number of visitors has increased considerably.
ngsl12:more.exampleChinese: 周末活动需要更多志愿者，因为游客数量大幅增加了。

ngsl12:get.exampleEnglish: You can get a free map at reception, which shows all the walking routes around the lake.
ngsl12:get.exampleChinese: 你可以在接待处领取免费地图，上面标着所有环湖步行路线。

ngsl12:who.exampleEnglish: Do you know who organised the workshop, because I would like to thank them for their help?
ngsl12:who.exampleChinese: 你知道是谁组织了这次工作坊吗？我想感谢他们的帮助。

ngsl12:like.exampleEnglish: I like working near the window because the natural light helps me concentrate during the afternoon.
ngsl12:like.exampleChinese: 我喜欢在窗边工作，因为自然光能帮助我在下午集中注意力。

ngsl12:when.exampleEnglish: We need to decide when the course should begin so that everyone has enough time to prepare.
ngsl12:when.exampleChinese: 我们需要决定课程何时开始，好让每个人都有足够时间准备。

ngsl12:think.exampleEnglish: I think the smaller venue would suit our event better, especially if fewer guests decide to come.
ngsl12:think.exampleChinese: 我觉得较小的场地更适合我们的活动，尤其是在来宾减少的情况下。

ngsl12:make.exampleEnglish: The children used recycled cardboard to make a model bridge that could support several small toy cars.
ngsl12:make.exampleChinese: 孩子们用回收纸板制作了一座能承受几辆小玩具车的桥模型。

ngsl12:time.exampleEnglish: We allowed extra time for the journey because the roads near the airport were being repaired.
ngsl12:time.exampleChinese: 我们为行程多留了时间，因为机场附近的道路正在维修。

ngsl12:see.exampleEnglish: From the upstairs window, we could see fishing boats returning to the harbour as the sun rose.
ngsl12:see.exampleChinese: 从楼上窗户，我们能看见渔船随着太阳升起驶回港口。

ngsl12:what.exampleEnglish: Please explain what the new symbols mean before we start using the updated version of the map.
ngsl12:what.exampleChinese: 在我们开始使用新版地图前，请解释一下这些新符号是什么意思。

ngsl12:up.exampleEnglish: The path climbs up the hillside before reaching a small café with wonderful views across the valley.
ngsl12:up.exampleChinese: 小路沿山坡向上，最后通往一家能俯瞰山谷美景的小咖啡馆。

ngsl12:some.exampleEnglish: We bought some fresh bread from the village bakery before setting off on our long journey home.
ngsl12:some.exampleChinese: 在踏上漫长的回家路之前，我们在村里的面包店买了些新鲜面包。

ngsl12:other.exampleEnglish: The main entrance was closed for repairs, so visitors had to use the other door beside the café.
ngsl12:other.exampleChinese: 正门因维修关闭，游客只好使用咖啡馆旁的另一扇门。

ngsl12:out.exampleEnglish: The children hurried out of the classroom when they heard that the snow had finally started falling.
ngsl12:out.exampleChinese: 听说终于开始下雪了，孩子们急忙跑出了教室。

ngsl12:good.exampleEnglish: The hotel received good reviews because its staff were helpful and the rooms were carefully maintained.
ngsl12:good.exampleChinese: 这家酒店获得了好评，因为员工热心，房间也维护得很好。

ngsl12:people.exampleEnglish: More people are choosing to cycle to work now that the city has built safer bicycle lanes.
ngsl12:people.exampleChinese: 城市建起更安全的自行车道后，更多人选择骑车上班。

ngsl12:year.exampleEnglish: We visit the same village every year, although we usually explore a different area of the countryside each time.
ngsl12:year.exampleChinese: 我们每年都去同一个村子，不过每次通常会探索不同的乡村区域。

ngsl12:take.exampleEnglish: Please take your umbrella when you leave, because the forecast suggests that heavy rain will return later.
ngsl12:take.exampleChinese: 离开时请带上雨伞，因为天气预报说稍后还会有大雨。

ngsl12:no.exampleEnglish: There was no space left in the cupboard, so we moved the extra plates to another room.
ngsl12:no.exampleChinese: 橱柜里没有空间了，所以我们把多余的盘子移到了另一个房间。

ngsl12:well.exampleEnglish: The two teams work well together, even though they approach difficult problems in very different ways.
ngsl12:well.exampleChinese: 这两个团队合作得很好，尽管他们处理难题的方式很不相同。

ngsl12:because.exampleEnglish: We booked an earlier train because we wanted enough time to explore the city before the concert.
ngsl12:because.exampleChinese: 我们订了更早的火车，因为想在音乐会前有足够时间游览城市。

ngsl12:very.exampleEnglish: The instructions were very clear, so everyone managed to assemble the shelves without asking for help.
ngsl12:very.exampleChinese: 说明非常清楚，所以大家不用寻求帮助就装好了架子。

ngsl12:just.exampleEnglish: I have just finished the report, so I can send you a copy before the afternoon meeting.
ngsl12:just.exampleChinese: 我刚刚完成报告，所以能在下午的会议前发给你一份。

ngsl12:come.exampleEnglish: Please come to the community meeting if you would like to help improve our local park.
ngsl12:come.exampleChinese: 如果你想帮助改善当地公园，请来参加社区会议。

ngsl12:could.exampleEnglish: When we lived near the coast, we could walk to the beach after dinner almost every evening.
ngsl12:could.exampleChinese: 以前住在海边时，我们几乎每晚饭后都能步行去海滩。

ngsl12:work.exampleEnglish: She enjoys her work at the museum because every exhibition gives her an opportunity to learn something new.
ngsl12:work.exampleChinese: 她喜欢博物馆的工作，因为每次展览都让她有机会学到新东西。

ngsl12:use.exampleEnglish: We use a shared calendar so that everyone knows when the meeting rooms are available for booking.
ngsl12:use.exampleChinese: 我们使用共享日历，让大家都知道会议室何时可以预订。

ngsl12:than.exampleEnglish: The new library is much quieter than the old one, making it easier for students to concentrate.
ngsl12:than.exampleChinese: 新图书馆比旧馆安静得多，让学生们更容易集中注意力。

ngsl12:now.exampleEnglish: The bridge has reopened, and drivers can now reach the town without taking a long route through the hills.
ngsl12:now.exampleChinese: 桥已经重新开放，司机们现在无需绕行山区就能到镇上。

ngsl12:then.exampleEnglish: We arrived in the village before sunrise, and the streets were almost completely empty back then.
ngsl12:then.exampleChinese: 我们日出前到达村子，那时候街道上几乎完全没有人。

ngsl12:also.exampleEnglish: The course teaches practical cooking skills, but it also explains how to plan meals on a limited budget.
ngsl12:also.exampleChinese: 课程教授实用烹饪技能，也讲解如何在预算有限的情况下安排膳食。

ngsl12:into.exampleEnglish: The guide led us into a narrow tunnel that connected the old house to the nearby river.
ngsl12:into.exampleChinese: 导游带我们进入一条狭窄隧道，它把老房子和附近的河连接起来。

ngsl12:only.exampleEnglish: Only a few visitors stayed until closing time, so we had a peaceful view of the final exhibition.
ngsl12:only.exampleChinese: 只有少数游客待到闭馆，所以我们能安静地欣赏最后一个展览。

ngsl12:look.exampleEnglish: Please look at the diagram carefully before you connect the cables to the back of the computer.
ngsl12:look.exampleChinese: 把电缆接到电脑背面之前，请仔细看一下示意图。

ngsl12:want.exampleEnglish: We want to find a quieter place to stay, preferably somewhere within walking distance of the station.
ngsl12:want.exampleChinese: 我们想找一个更安静的住宿地点，最好离车站只有步行距离。

ngsl12:give.exampleEnglish: The receptionist will give you a visitor's badge after you have written your name in the book.
ngsl12:give.exampleChinese: 你在登记簿上写下姓名后，接待员会给你一张访客证。

ngsl12:first.exampleEnglish: Our first attempt failed because we had not checked whether all the pieces fitted together correctly.
ngsl12:first.exampleChinese: 我们的第一次尝试失败了，因为没有检查所有零件是否正确吻合。

ngsl12:new.exampleEnglish: The new walking route passes several small farms that visitors could not easily reach before the bridge opened.
ngsl12:new.exampleChinese: 新步行路线经过几座小农场，桥开通前游客很难到达那里。

ngsl12:way.exampleEnglish: We need a better way to share information so that important messages do not get lost.
ngsl12:way.exampleChinese: 我们需要更好的信息共享方法，以免重要消息遗漏。

ngsl12:find.exampleEnglish: After searching through several boxes, I finally managed to find the photographs my grandmother had mentioned.
ngsl12:find.exampleChinese: 翻找几个箱子后，我终于找到了奶奶提过的照片。

ngsl12:over.exampleEnglish: We crossed over the wooden bridge slowly because some of the boards were slippery after the rain.
ngsl12:over.exampleChinese: 我们慢慢走过木桥，因为雨后有些木板很滑。

ngsl12:any.exampleEnglish: If you have any questions about the schedule, please speak to the organiser before the session begins.
ngsl12:any.exampleChinese: 如果你对日程有任何疑问，请在活动开始前向组织者询问。

ngsl12:after.exampleEnglish: We watched the children enter the museum, and their teacher followed shortly after with the tickets.
ngsl12:after.exampleChinese: 我们看着孩子们走进博物馆，不久后老师拿着票跟了进去。

ngsl12:day.exampleEnglish: We spent a whole day exploring the island, stopping whenever we found a quiet beach or interesting village.
ngsl12:day.exampleChinese: 我们花了一整天游览岛屿，每遇到安静的海滩或有趣的村子就停下来。

ngsl12:where.exampleEnglish: The guide explained where we should wait if the group became separated during the busy festival.
ngsl12:where.exampleChinese: 导游说明了，如果节日期间人多导致队伍走散，我们应该在哪里等候。

ngsl12:thing.exampleEnglish: I cannot remember the name of the small thing that keeps the cupboard door firmly closed.
ngsl12:thing.exampleChinese: 我记不起来那个能把橱柜门扣紧的小东西叫什么。

ngsl12:most.exampleEnglish: Most of the volunteers had never met before, but they quickly learned how to work together.
ngsl12:most.exampleChinese: 大多数志愿者以前从未见过，却很快学会了如何合作。

ngsl12:should.exampleEnglish: You should keep a copy of the receipt in case you need to return the product later.
ngsl12:should.exampleChinese: 你应该保存一份收据，以防之后需要退货。

ngsl12:need.exampleEnglish: We need a larger room for the workshop because more people have registered than we originally expected.
ngsl12:need.exampleChinese: 工作坊需要更大的房间，因为报名人数超出了最初预期。

ngsl12:much.exampleEnglish: Much of what we learned during the workshop can be used immediately in our everyday work.
ngsl12:much.exampleChinese: 我们在工作坊学到的许多东西，都能立刻用于日常工作。

ngsl12:right.exampleEnglish: Keep your bag in your right hand while you use the other hand to hold the rail.
ngsl12:right.exampleChinese: 用右手提着包，同时用另一只手扶住栏杆。

ngsl12:how.exampleEnglish: The instructor explained how we could adjust the camera settings to take clearer photographs in poor light.
ngsl12:how.exampleChinese: 教练讲解了如何调整相机设置，以便在光线差时拍出更清晰的照片。

ngsl12:back.exampleEnglish: We used the back entrance because a delivery van was blocking the main door of the shop.
ngsl12:back.exampleChinese: 我们走了后门，因为一辆送货车挡住了商店正门。

ngsl12:mean.exampleEnglish: The coloured lines mean different things, so check the guide before you begin following the route.
ngsl12:mean.exampleChinese: 这些彩色线条含义不同，所以沿路线走之前先查看指南。

ngsl12:even.exampleEnglish: The basic ticket includes the gardens and even gives visitors access to the newly restored tower.
ngsl12:even.exampleChinese: 基础门票包含花园，甚至还允许游客进入新修复的塔楼。

ngsl12:may.exampleEnglish: The outdoor concert may finish earlier than planned if the temperature drops sharply after the sun goes down.
ngsl12:may.exampleChinese: 如果日落后气温骤降，户外音乐会可能会提前结束。

ngsl12:here.exampleEnglish: Please leave your bicycle here while you collect your ticket from the office across the road.
ngsl12:here.exampleChinese: 你去马路对面的办公室取票时，请把自行车留在这里。

ngsl12:many.exampleEnglish: Many local shops stayed open late because the festival attracted visitors from all over the region.
ngsl12:many.exampleChinese: 许多当地商店营业到很晚，因为节日吸引了整个地区的游客。

ngsl12:such.exampleEnglish: We had never seen such clear water before, so we spent the whole afternoon beside the lake.
ngsl12:such.exampleChinese: 我们从没见过如此清澈的水，于是在湖边待了整个下午。

ngsl12:last.exampleEnglish: The last bus leaves before the exhibition closes, so we will need to arrange another way home.
ngsl12:last.exampleChinese: 末班车在展览闭馆前发车，因此我们得另想办法回家。

ngsl12:child.exampleEnglish: Every child who joins the activity must bring a warm coat, even if the morning seems sunny.
ngsl12:child.exampleChinese: 参加活动的每个孩子都必须带厚外套，即使早上看起来天气晴朗。

ngsl12:tell.exampleEnglish: Please tell the receptionist if you need a quieter room, as several alternatives are still available upstairs.
ngsl12:tell.exampleChinese: 如果你需要更安静的房间，请告诉接待员，楼上还有几个可选房间。

ngsl12:really.exampleEnglish: The new cycle path is really useful because it connects our neighbourhood directly to the station.
ngsl12:really.exampleChinese: 新自行车道非常实用，因为它把我们的社区直接连到了车站。

ngsl12:call.exampleEnglish: I will call the shop tomorrow morning to check whether the replacement part has finally arrived.
ngsl12:call.exampleChinese: 我明早会给商店打电话，确认替换零件是否终于到货。

ngsl12:before.exampleEnglish: We had visited the village before, but we had never explored the forest beyond the old mill.
ngsl12:before.exampleChinese: 我们以前到过这个村子，却从未探索过老磨坊外的森林。

ngsl12:company.exampleEnglish: The company offers flexible working hours, allowing employees to avoid the busiest trains during the morning.
ngsl12:company.exampleChinese: 这家公司提供弹性工作时间，让员工能避开早上最拥挤的火车。

ngsl12:through.exampleEnglish: We followed the path through the forest until we reached a clearing beside a narrow stream.
ngsl12:through.exampleChinese: 我们沿着穿过森林的小路前进，最后到达一条小溪旁的空地。

ngsl12:down.exampleEnglish: The children walked down the steep steps carefully because the stone surface was wet from rain.
ngsl12:down.exampleChinese: 孩子们小心地走下陡峭台阶，因为石面被雨水打湿了。

ngsl12:show.exampleEnglish: Could you show the new volunteers how to use the equipment before the first visitors arrive?
ngsl12:show.exampleChinese: 你能在首批游客到来前，教新志愿者如何使用这些设备吗？

ngsl12:life.exampleEnglish: The discovery of plant life in the tiny pond encouraged the children to study its surroundings more carefully.
ngsl12:life.exampleChinese: 小池塘里发现植物生命，促使孩子们更仔细地研究周围环境。

ngsl12:man.exampleEnglish: A man waiting outside the station offered to help when he saw us struggling with our suitcases.
ngsl12:man.exampleChinese: 一位在车站外等候的男子看到我们费力地搬行李，主动提出帮忙。

ngsl12:change.exampleEnglish: We may need to change our plans if the museum remains closed throughout the school holidays.
ngsl12:change.exampleChinese: 如果博物馆在整个学校假期都闭馆，我们可能需要改变计划。

ngsl12:place.exampleEnglish: Please place the completed forms in the blue tray so that staff can collect them later.
ngsl12:place.exampleChinese: 请把填好的表格放进蓝色托盘，方便工作人员稍后收取。

ngsl12:long.exampleEnglish: A long wooden bridge connects the island to the shore, allowing visitors to cross on foot.
ngsl12:long.exampleChinese: 一座很长的木桥把岛屿和岸边连起来，游客可以步行通过。

ngsl12:between.exampleEnglish: The little café stands between the library and the station, making it a convenient meeting place.
ngsl12:between.exampleChinese: 小咖啡馆位于图书馆和车站之间，是一个方便的会面地点。

ngsl12:feel.exampleEnglish: I feel much more confident about speaking English now that I practise with a partner every week.
ngsl12:feel.exampleChinese: 现在我每周都和搭档练习，对说英语自信多了。

ngsl12:too.exampleEnglish: The room was too crowded for a practical workshop, so the organiser moved us into the hall.
ngsl12:too.exampleChinese: 房间太挤，无法开展实践工作坊，因此组织者让我们移到了大厅。

ngsl12:still.exampleEnglish: We still use the wooden table my grandfather made, although its surface has become slightly uneven.
ngsl12:still.exampleChinese: 我们仍在用爷爷做的木桌，虽然桌面已经有些不平了。

ngsl12:problem.exampleEnglish: The main problem was the lack of storage space, which made the small kitchen difficult to organise.
ngsl12:problem.exampleChinese: 主要问题是缺少储物空间，这让小厨房很难整理。

ngsl12:write.exampleEnglish: Please write your contact details clearly so that the organiser can reach you if the schedule changes.
ngsl12:write.exampleChinese: 请清楚填写联系方式，方便组织者在日程变动时联系你。

ngsl12:same.exampleEnglish: We chose the same hotel as last year because its location had made exploring the city easy.
ngsl12:same.exampleChinese: 我们选了去年的同一家酒店，因为它的位置方便游览城市。

ngsl12:lot.exampleEnglish: We learned a lot from the first attempt, even though the model did not work as expected.
ngsl12:lot.exampleChinese: 虽然模型没有按预期运作，但第一次尝试让我们学到了很多。

ngsl12:great.exampleEnglish: The community garden has been a great success, bringing together neighbours who rarely spoke to each other before.
ngsl12:great.exampleChinese: 社区花园取得了巨大成功，让以前很少交谈的邻居们聚在一起。

ngsl12:try.exampleEnglish: We should try a different route tomorrow because the coastal road is likely to be very busy.
ngsl12:try.exampleChinese: 我们明天应该尝试别的路线，因为沿海道路可能会很拥堵。

ngsl12:leave.exampleEnglish: We decided to leave the campsite early so that we could reach the village before the storm.
ngsl12:leave.exampleChinese: 我们决定提早离开营地，以便在暴风雨前赶到村子。

ngsl12:number.exampleEnglish: Write the reference number on the envelope so that staff can match your documents to the correct application.
ngsl12:number.exampleChinese: 请在信封上写明参考编号，方便工作人员把文件匹配到正确的申请。

ngsl12:both.exampleEnglish: Both routes offer beautiful views, but the one along the coast is easier for inexperienced walkers.
ngsl12:both.exampleChinese: 两条路线景色都很美，但沿海那条更适合没有经验的徒步者。

ngsl12:own.exampleEnglish: We prepared our own lunch instead of buying food, which helped us keep the trip affordable.
ngsl12:own.exampleChinese: 我们自备午饭而没有买吃的，这有助于控制旅行费用。

ngsl12:part.exampleEnglish: We repaired the damaged part of the fence before the animals were allowed back into the field.
ngsl12:part.exampleChinese: 动物们获准回到田里前，我们修好了围栏受损的部分。

ngsl12:point.exampleEnglish: Please point to the symbol on the map so that everyone understands which entrance we should use.
ngsl12:point.exampleChinese: 请指一下地图上的符号，让大家都明白该使用哪个入口。

ngsl12:little.exampleEnglish: The little house beside the bridge has been carefully restored and now welcomes visitors during summer.
ngsl12:little.exampleChinese: 桥边的小房子经过精心修复，现在夏季会接待游客。

ngsl12:help.exampleEnglish: The guide offered to help us choose a walking route that would suit everyone in our group.
ngsl12:help.exampleChinese: 导游主动帮助我们选择一条适合队里所有人的徒步路线。

ngsl12:ask.exampleEnglish: You should ask a member of staff for permission before taking photographs inside the main exhibition hall.
ngsl12:ask.exampleChinese: 在主展厅内拍照前，你应该先向工作人员请求许可。

ngsl12:meet.exampleEnglish: We arranged to meet outside the library because everyone could reach it easily by public transport.
ngsl12:meet.exampleChinese: 我们约好在图书馆外见面，因为大家坐公共交通都能方便到达。

ngsl12:start.exampleEnglish: The start of the walking tour was delayed because several visitors had difficulty finding the meeting point.
ngsl12:start.exampleChinese: 徒步导览推迟开始，因为几位游客找不到集合地点。

ngsl12:talk.exampleEnglish: We should talk about the problem calmly before deciding whether the original plan needs to be changed.
ngsl12:talk.exampleChinese: 我们应该先冷静讨论问题，再决定是否需要更改原计划。

ngsl12:something.exampleEnglish: I need something that will keep these papers together without damaging the photographs attached to them.
ngsl12:something.exampleChinese: 我需要一个能把这些纸夹在一起、又不损伤所附照片的东西。

ngsl12:put.exampleEnglish: Please put the chairs against the wall so that there is enough space for the group activity.
ngsl12:put.exampleChinese: 请把椅子靠墙放，为小组活动留出足够空间。

collocations.english: put a book on the table

ngsl12:another.exampleEnglish: We need another volunteer to welcome visitors while the rest of the team prepares the main hall.
ngsl12:another.exampleChinese: 我们还需要一名志愿者接待游客，同时其余队员准备大厅。

ngsl12:become.exampleEnglish: With regular practice, tasks that once seemed difficult can become much easier to complete without help.
ngsl12:become.exampleChinese: 经常练习后，曾经看似困难的任务会变得更容易独立完成。

ngsl12:interest.exampleEnglish: The guide used old photographs to interest visitors in the everyday lives of the village's former residents.
ngsl12:interest.exampleChinese: 导游用老照片激发游客对村中昔日居民日常生活的兴趣。

ngsl12:country.exampleEnglish: Travelling through the country by train allowed us to see places that most tourists never visit.
ngsl12:country.exampleChinese: 乘火车穿越这个国家，让我们看到了多数游客从不到访的地方。

ngsl12:old.exampleEnglish: The old bridge is no longer used by cars, but people still cross it on foot.
ngsl12:old.exampleChinese: 这座老桥已不再通汽车，但人们仍会步行过桥。

ngsl12:each.exampleEnglish: Each participant received a different photograph and was asked to describe it without showing it to anyone.
ngsl12:each.exampleChinese: 每位参与者收到一张不同的照片，要在不展示给别人的情况下描述它。

ngsl12:school.exampleEnglish: The school opened its library on Saturdays so that local families could borrow books together.
ngsl12:school.exampleChinese: 学校周六开放图书馆，方便当地家庭一起借书。

ngsl12:late.exampleEnglish: We enjoyed a late dinner after the concert, when most of the nearby restaurants were already closed.
ngsl12:late.exampleChinese: 音乐会后我们很晚才吃晚饭，当时附近多数餐馆已经关门。

ngsl12:high.exampleEnglish: The high wall protected the garden from strong winds, allowing several delicate plants to grow successfully.
ngsl12:high.exampleChinese: 高墙挡住了强风，让几种娇弱的植物得以顺利生长。

ngsl12:different.exampleEnglish: We tried three different methods before finding one that was simple enough for everyone to use.
ngsl12:different.exampleChinese: 我们尝试了三种不同方法，才找到一种人人都能使用的简单方法。

ngsl12:off.exampleEnglish: The cover was off the machine, so the technician could see which part needed to be replaced.
ngsl12:off.exampleChinese: 机器外罩已经取下，技术员因此能看出哪个零件需要更换。

ngsl12:next.exampleEnglish: The next stage of the project involves testing the design with people who have never seen it before.
ngsl12:next.exampleChinese: 项目的下一阶段，是让从没见过设计的人来测试它。

ngsl12:end.exampleEnglish: We waited until the end of the performance before asking the musicians about their unusual instruments.
ngsl12:end.exampleChinese: 我们等到演出结束，才向音乐家询问那些不寻常的乐器。

ngsl12:live.exampleEnglish: Some trees can live for hundreds of years if they have enough space and suitable growing conditions.
ngsl12:live.exampleChinese: 有足够空间和合适生长条件时，有些树能活数百年。

ngsl12:why.exampleEnglish: Nobody understood why the lights kept going out until the technician checked the old wiring carefully.
ngsl12:why.exampleChinese: 直到技术员仔细检查了旧线路，大家才明白为什么灯总是熄灭。

ngsl12:while.exampleEnglish: I prepared the vegetables while my brother read the recipe and checked which ingredients we still needed.
ngsl12:while.exampleChinese: 我准备蔬菜时，弟弟读食谱并核对我们还缺哪些食材。

ngsl12:world.exampleEnglish: The festival brings together musicians from around the world, giving local audiences a chance to discover unfamiliar styles.
ngsl12:world.exampleChinese: 音乐节汇集世界各地的音乐家，让当地观众有机会接触陌生的风格。

ngsl12:week.exampleEnglish: We spent a week in the countryside, exploring small villages and learning how local farmers produced cheese.
ngsl12:week.exampleChinese: 我们在乡下待了一周，游览小村庄，了解当地农民如何制作奶酪。

ngsl12:play.exampleEnglish: We usually play basketball after school, unless the sports hall is being used for another activity.
ngsl12:play.exampleChinese: 我们通常放学后打篮球，除非体育馆被其他活动占用了。

ngsl12:might.exampleEnglish: The café might be closed when we arrive, so it would be sensible to bring some food.
ngsl12:might.exampleChinese: 我们到达时咖啡馆可能关门，所以带些食物比较稳妥。

ngsl12:must.exampleEnglish: Visitors must keep to the marked paths because several areas contain plants that are easily damaged.
ngsl12:must.exampleChinese: 游客必须沿标记小路行走，因为几个区域生长着易受损的植物。

ngsl12:home.exampleEnglish: Their new home is close to the station, which makes visiting relatives much easier at weekends.
ngsl12:home.exampleChinese: 他们的新家靠近车站，周末探望亲戚就方便多了。

ngsl12:never.exampleEnglish: I had never used this kind of camera before, so I read the instructions before taking photographs.
ngsl12:never.exampleChinese: 我以前从没用过这种相机，所以拍照前先读了说明书。

ngsl12:include.exampleEnglish: The ticket price will include a guided tour, although visitors must pay separately for the practical workshop.
ngsl12:include.exampleChinese: 票价将包含导览，但实践工作坊需要游客另外付费。

ngsl12:course.exampleEnglish: The river changed its course after the storm, leaving part of the old walking path under water.
ngsl12:course.exampleChinese: 暴风雨后河流改道，旧步道的一部分被淹在水下。

ngsl12:house.exampleEnglish: The house at the end of the lane has a garden that overlooks the entire valley.
ngsl12:house.exampleChinese: 小巷尽头那栋房子的花园能俯瞰整个山谷。

ngsl12:report.exampleEnglish: The report explains why the bridge needs repairs and suggests how the work could be completed safely.
ngsl12:report.exampleChinese: 报告解释了桥为何需要维修，并建议如何安全完成施工。

ngsl12:group.exampleEnglish: Our group included several experienced walkers who helped the younger children cross the stream safely.
ngsl12:group.exampleChinese: 我们组里有几位经验丰富的徒步者，帮助较小的孩子安全过溪。

ngsl12:case.exampleEnglish: The missing delivery was an unusual case, because every other parcel had arrived at the correct address.
ngsl12:case.exampleChinese: 这次投递丢失很不寻常，因为其他每个包裹都送对了地址。

ngsl12:woman.exampleEnglish: The woman leading the workshop encouraged everyone to share a practical skill they had learned at home.
ngsl12:woman.exampleChinese: 主持工作坊的女士鼓励每个人分享一项在家学到的实用技能。

ngsl12:around.exampleEnglish: There were benches all around the lake, so visitors could stop whenever they wanted to enjoy the view.
ngsl12:around.exampleChinese: 湖的四周都有长椅，游客想欣赏景色时随时可以停下。

ngsl12:book.exampleEnglish: The book contains detailed maps and useful advice for people who prefer travelling without a tour guide.
ngsl12:book.exampleChinese: 这本书包含详细地图和实用建议，供喜欢不跟导游旅行的人使用。

ngsl12:family.exampleEnglish: Her family moved to the town last summer, but they have already become involved in several local activities.
ngsl12:family.exampleChinese: 她家去年夏天搬到镇上，但他们已经参与了好几项当地活动。

ngsl12:seem.exampleEnglish: The instructions seem complicated at first, but the task becomes much simpler once you start practising.
ngsl12:seem.exampleChinese: 说明乍看很复杂，但一开始练习，任务就简单多了。

ngsl12:let.exampleEnglish: The organisers will let us use the hall if we promise to leave everything clean afterwards.
ngsl12:let.exampleChinese: 如果我们保证事后打扫干净，组织者就会允许我们使用大厅。

ngsl12:again.exampleEnglish: We decided to visit the exhibition again because there had been too many people on our first visit.
ngsl12:again.exampleChinese: 我们决定再看一次展览，因为第一次去的时候人太多了。

ngsl12:kind.exampleEnglish: This kind of material is useful for outdoor furniture because it does not easily absorb water.
ngsl12:kind.exampleChinese: 这种材料适合制作户外家具，因为它不容易吸水。

ngsl12:keep.exampleEnglish: You can keep the guidebook after the tour, so there is no need to return it.
ngsl12:keep.exampleChinese: 导览结束后你可以保留指南，不必归还。

ngsl12:hear.exampleEnglish: We could hear music coming from the square long before we saw the musicians standing there.
ngsl12:hear.exampleChinese: 还没看到站在广场上的音乐家，我们就远远听到了音乐。

ngsl12:system.exampleEnglish: The new booking system allows visitors to choose a time that suits them without calling the office.
ngsl12:system.exampleChinese: 新的预订系统让游客无需打电话，就能选择适合自己的时间。

ngsl12:every.exampleEnglish: Every visitor received a reusable cup so that the festival would produce less waste than before.
ngsl12:every.exampleChinese: 每位游客都得到一个可重复使用的杯子，让音乐节比以前产生更少垃圾。

ngsl12:question.exampleEnglish: The guide encouraged us to question the information on old maps rather than accept every detail as accurate.
ngsl12:question.exampleChinese: 导游鼓励我们质疑旧地图上的信息，而不是认定所有细节都准确。

ngsl12:during.exampleEnglish: We took notes during the demonstration because the instructor explained several techniques that were completely new to us.
ngsl12:during.exampleChinese: 演示时我们做了笔记，因为教练讲了几种我们完全没接触过的技巧。

ngsl12:always.exampleEnglish: The library always keeps a few tables free for visitors who have not been able to book.
ngsl12:always.exampleChinese: 图书馆总会留几张空桌，给没能预约到的访客使用。

ngsl12:big.exampleEnglish: The new community hall is big enough to host concerts as well as regular classes and meetings.
ngsl12:big.exampleChinese: 新社区大厅足够大，既能举办音乐会，也能开展常规课程和会议。

ngsl12:set.exampleEnglish: We bought a complete set of tools so that everyone could take part in the repair workshop.
ngsl12:set.exampleChinese: 我们买了一套完整工具，让每个人都能参加维修工作坊。

ngsl12:small.exampleEnglish: The village has a small library, but its collection includes books in several different languages.
ngsl12:small.exampleChinese: 村里有一座小图书馆，但馆藏包括好几种语言的书。

ngsl12:study.exampleEnglish: We study local plants during our weekly walks, recording any changes that we notice throughout the year.
ngsl12:study.exampleChinese: 我们在每周散步时研究当地植物，记录一年中注意到的各种变化。

ngsl12:follow.exampleEnglish: Please follow the guide closely because the path becomes narrow where it passes through the rocky area.
ngsl12:follow.exampleChinese: 请紧跟导游，因为小路经过岩石区时会变得狭窄。

ngsl12:begin.exampleEnglish: The workshop will begin once everyone has found a seat and checked that their materials are complete.
ngsl12:begin.exampleChinese: 大家找到座位并核对材料齐全后，工作坊就会开始。

ngsl12:important.exampleEnglish: It is important to check the route beforehand, especially when some members of the group are inexperienced.
ngsl12:important.exampleChinese: 提前核查路线很重要，尤其是当组里有人缺乏经验时。

ngsl12:since.exampleEnglish: We have used the same meeting room since the club opened, although the building has changed considerably.
ngsl12:since.exampleChinese: 俱乐部成立以来，我们一直用同一间会议室，尽管整栋楼变化很大。

ngsl12:run.exampleEnglish: We usually run along the river before breakfast, when the paths are quiet and the air is cool.
ngsl12:run.exampleChinese: 我们通常在早饭前沿河跑步，那时小路安静，空气凉爽。

ngsl12:under.exampleEnglish: The spare chairs are under the stairs, where they can be stored without blocking the main entrance.
ngsl12:under.exampleChinese: 备用椅子在楼梯下，可以存放在那里而不堵住正门。

ngsl12:turn.exampleEnglish: The driver had to turn the bus around because the narrow road ahead was completely blocked.
ngsl12:turn.exampleChinese: 司机不得不把公交车掉头，因为前面的窄路完全堵住了。

ngsl12:few.exampleEnglish: Few visitors realised that the small building behind the museum had once been the village school.
ngsl12:few.exampleChinese: 很少有游客知道，博物馆后面的小楼曾是村里的学校。

ngsl12:bring.exampleEnglish: Please bring a notebook to the workshop so that you can record any ideas you want to try.
ngsl12:bring.exampleChinese: 请带笔记本来工作坊，方便记下你想尝试的点子。

ngsl12:early.exampleEnglish: The early train was less crowded, which gave us plenty of space to sit together during the journey.
ngsl12:early.exampleChinese: 早班火车没那么拥挤，路上我们有充足空间坐在一起。

ngsl12:hand.exampleEnglish: She raised her hand to ask whether the group could visit the tower after the main tour.
ngsl12:hand.exampleChinese: 她举手询问，团队是否能在主要导览结束后参观塔楼。

ngsl12:state.exampleEnglish: The state government introduced new rules to protect the forests that attract visitors from neighbouring regions.
ngsl12:state.exampleChinese: 州政府出台了新规定，保护那些吸引邻近地区游客的森林。

ngsl12:move.exampleEnglish: We need to move the table closer to the window so that the photographs receive more natural light.
ngsl12:move.exampleChinese: 我们得把桌子移近窗户，让照片得到更多自然光。

ngsl12:money.exampleEnglish: We saved enough money for the trip by preparing meals at home instead of eating out.
ngsl12:money.exampleChinese: 我们通过在家做饭而不是外出吃饭，攒够了旅行的钱。

ngsl12:fact.exampleEnglish: The guide checked every fact before publishing the booklet, because earlier editions had contained several mistakes.
ngsl12:fact.exampleChinese: 导游出版小册子前核实了每个事实，因为早先版本存在几处错误。

ngsl12:however.exampleEnglish: The route looked short on the map; however, several steep hills made the walk much more tiring.
ngsl12:however.exampleChinese: 地图上的路线看起来很短，然而几座陡坡让徒步累了不少。

ngsl12:area.exampleEnglish: The area around the old station has become more popular since several independent shops opened there.
ngsl12:area.exampleChinese: 老车站周边的地区自从开了几家独立商店后，越来越受欢迎。

ngsl12:provide.exampleEnglish: The organisers provide all the necessary materials, so participants only need to bring their own notebooks.
ngsl12:provide.exampleChinese: 组织者提供全部必要材料，因此参与者只需自带笔记本。

ngsl12:name.exampleEnglish: Please write your name on the box so that nobody takes your materials home by mistake.
ngsl12:name.exampleChinese: 请在盒子上写上姓名，以免有人误把你的材料带回家。

ngsl12:read.exampleEnglish: I usually read the instructions twice before using unfamiliar equipment, especially when several parts look similar.
ngsl12:read.exampleChinese: 使用不熟悉的设备前，我通常读两遍说明，尤其是几个零件很相似时。

ngsl12:friend.exampleEnglish: A friend who knows the city well offered to show us some places beyond the usual tourist routes.
ngsl12:friend.exampleChinese: 一位熟悉这座城市的朋友主动带我们去常规旅游路线之外的一些地方。

ngsl12:month.exampleEnglish: The exhibition changes every month, giving regular visitors a reason to return and discover something different.
ngsl12:month.exampleChinese: 展览每月更换，让常来的游客有理由回来发现不同的东西。

ngsl12:large.exampleEnglish: The large windows allow plenty of daylight into the hall, reducing the need for artificial lighting.
ngsl12:large.exampleChinese: 大窗户让充足日光进入大厅，减少了对人工照明的需求。

ngsl12:business.exampleEnglish: The family started a small business selling handmade furniture, which gradually attracted customers from other towns.
ngsl12:business.exampleChinese: 这家人创办了一家销售手工家具的小企业，逐渐吸引了其他城镇的顾客。

ngsl12:without.exampleEnglish: We managed to assemble the shelves without any help, although the instructions were not particularly clear.
ngsl12:without.exampleChinese: 尽管说明不太清楚，我们还是在没人帮助的情况下装好了架子。

ngsl12:information.exampleEnglish: The website provides detailed information about walking routes, including their length and the facilities available nearby.
ngsl12:information.exampleChinese: 网站提供详细的徒步路线信息，包括路线长度和附近可用设施。

ngsl12:open.exampleEnglish: The garden remains open throughout the winter, although the small café only serves visitors at weekends.
ngsl12:open.exampleChinese: 花园整个冬天都开放，但小咖啡馆仅在周末接待游客。

ngsl12:order.exampleEnglish: We decided to order lunch before visiting the gallery because the restaurant becomes busy after midday.
ngsl12:order.exampleChinese: 我们决定参观画廊前先点午饭，因为餐馆中午以后会变忙。

ngsl12:government.exampleEnglish: The government announced plans to improve public transport in rural areas where bus services had recently been reduced.
ngsl12:government.exampleChinese: 政府宣布计划改善公交班次近期减少的农村地区的公共交通。

ngsl12:word.exampleEnglish: I understood every word in the sentence, but the expression as a whole still confused me.
ngsl12:word.exampleChinese: 句子里的每个词我都懂，但整个表达仍让我困惑。

ngsl12:issue.exampleEnglish: The main issue at the meeting was how to keep the library open during the repairs.
ngsl12:issue.exampleChinese: 会议的主要议题是，如何在维修期间维持图书馆开放。

ngsl12:market.exampleEnglish: The weekly market attracts visitors who want fresh vegetables and products made by people from nearby villages.
ngsl12:market.exampleChinese: 每周的集市吸引着想购买新鲜蔬菜和附近村民制作产品的游客。

ngsl12:pay.exampleEnglish: Visitors can pay by card at the entrance, but the café only accepts cash during busy periods.
ngsl12:pay.exampleChinese: 游客可以在入口刷卡付款，但咖啡馆在繁忙时段只收现金。

ngsl12:build.exampleEnglish: The students helped build a wooden shelter where visitors could rest while exploring the nature reserve.
ngsl12:build.exampleChinese: 学生们帮忙搭建了一个木棚，供游览自然保护区的游客休息。

ngsl12:hold.exampleEnglish: Please hold the ladder steady while I check whether the box on the top shelf is ours.
ngsl12:hold.exampleChinese: 我确认顶层架上的箱子是否属于我们时，请扶稳梯子。

ngsl12:service.exampleEnglish: You should service the bicycle regularly if you want it to remain reliable throughout the winter.
ngsl12:service.exampleChinese: 如果你想让自行车整个冬天都可靠，就应该定期保养它。

ngsl12:against.exampleEnglish: Several residents spoke against the proposal because they believed it would make the narrow street less safe.
ngsl12:against.exampleChinese: 几位居民发言反对这项提案，因为他们认为这会让狭窄街道更不安全。

ngsl12:believe.exampleEnglish: I believe the project can succeed, provided that everyone understands their responsibilities and shares information regularly.
ngsl12:believe.exampleChinese: 我相信这个项目能成功，前提是每个人都清楚职责并定期共享信息。

ngsl12:second.exampleEnglish: Our second attempt was more successful because we had corrected the mistakes made during the first test.
ngsl12:second.exampleChinese: 第二次尝试更成功，因为我们修正了第一次测试中的错误。

ngsl12:though.exampleEnglish: The journey took longer than expected; the views from the mountain train made it worthwhile, though.
ngsl12:though.exampleChinese: 旅程比预期更久，不过山间列车沿途的景色让它很值得。

ngsl12:yes.exampleEnglish: When the organiser asked whether we could stay a little longer, we said yes without any hesitation.
ngsl12:yes.exampleChinese: 组织者问我们能否多待一会儿时，我们毫不犹豫地答应了。

ngsl12:love.exampleEnglish: Although they live far apart, the sisters love each other deeply and speak on the phone every evening.
ngsl12:love.exampleChinese: 虽然姐妹俩相隔很远，但她们彼此深爱，每晚都打电话。

ngsl12:increase.exampleEnglish: The library plans to increase its opening hours so that people working late can borrow books more easily.
ngsl12:increase.exampleChinese: 图书馆计划延长开放时间，方便下班晚的人借书。

ngsl12:job.exampleEnglish: Her new job involves organising events for visitors who want to learn more about the region.
ngsl12:job.exampleChinese: 她的新工作包括为想深入了解该地区的游客组织活动。

ngsl12:plan.exampleEnglish: We need to plan the journey carefully because there are very few places to stop along the route.
ngsl12:plan.exampleChinese: 我们需要仔细规划行程，因为沿途可供停留的地方很少。

ngsl12:result.exampleEnglish: A lack of clear instructions can result in mistakes, even when the people involved are highly experienced.
ngsl12:result.exampleChinese: 说明不清楚可能导致出错，即使参与者经验十分丰富。

ngsl12:away.exampleEnglish: The nearest supermarket is several kilometres away, so we usually buy enough food for the whole week.
ngsl12:away.exampleChinese: 最近的超市有几公里远，因此我们通常买够一周的食物。

ngsl12:example.exampleEnglish: The restored watermill is a fine example of the buildings that once supported life in this valley.
ngsl12:example.exampleChinese: 修复后的水磨坊很好地代表了曾支撑这个山谷居民生活的建筑。

ngsl12:happen.exampleEnglish: If a delay does happen, the organiser will send a message explaining when the activity can begin.
ngsl12:happen.exampleChinese: 如果确实出现延误，组织者会发消息说明活动何时能开始。

ngsl12:offer.exampleEnglish: The guide will offer advice on suitable walking routes before you set off into the hills.
ngsl12:offer.exampleChinese: 向山里出发前，导游会就合适的步行路线提供建议。

ngsl12:young.exampleEnglish: The young trees need protection from strong winds until their roots have had enough time to develop.
ngsl12:young.exampleChinese: 幼树需要避开强风，直到根系有充分时间发育。

ngsl12:close.exampleEnglish: We stood close to the guide so that we could hear her explanation above the street noise.
ngsl12:close.exampleChinese: 我们站得离导游很近，以便在街道噪声中听清她的讲解。

ngsl12:program.exampleEnglish: The training program combines practical tasks with discussion, helping new volunteers prepare for several different responsibilities.
ngsl12:program.exampleChinese: 培训项目把实践任务和讨论结合起来，帮助新志愿者为几种不同职责作准备。

ngsl12:lead.exampleEnglish: An experienced volunteer will lead the group through the forest, stopping to explain how the landscape has changed.
ngsl12:lead.exampleChinese: 一位经验丰富的志愿者将带队穿越森林，并停下来解释地貌如何变化。

ngsl12:buy.exampleEnglish: We decided to buy a reusable bottle because it would be more convenient during our walking holidays.
ngsl12:buy.exampleChinese: 我们决定买一个可重复使用的水瓶，因为徒步度假时会更方便。

ngsl12:understand.exampleEnglish: Once you understand how the booking system works, you can reserve a room without asking for help.
ngsl12:understand.exampleChinese: 一旦明白预订系统如何运作，你就可以独立预订房间。

ngsl12:thank.exampleEnglish: I would like to thank everyone who stayed after the event to help us clear the hall.
ngsl12:thank.exampleChinese: 我要感谢活动结束后留下来帮我们清理大厅的所有人。

ngsl12:far.exampleEnglish: The far end of the garden was too shady for vegetables, so we planted flowers there instead.
ngsl12:far.exampleChinese: 花园远端过于阴暗，不适合种菜，因此我们改在那里种花。

ngsl12:today.exampleEnglish: The town looks very different today because many old industrial buildings have been converted into homes and studios.
ngsl12:today.exampleChinese: 如今镇上面貌很不一样，因为许多旧工业建筑被改成了住宅和工作室。

ngsl12:hour.exampleEnglish: The journey takes about an hour if the traffic is light, but much longer during the evening.
ngsl12:hour.exampleChinese: 交通顺畅时路程大约一小时，但晚间会长得多。

ngsl12:student.exampleEnglish: Every student was asked to explain their design before the class voted for the most practical solution.
ngsl12:student.exampleChinese: 每个学生都要先解释自己的设计，然后全班投票选出最实用的方案。

ngsl12:face.exampleEnglish: The cold wind made her face turn red while she waited outside the station for her friends.
ngsl12:face.exampleChinese: 她在车站外等朋友时，寒风把她的脸吹红了。

ngsl12:hope.exampleEnglish: Our hope is that the new garden will encourage neighbours to spend more time talking to each other.
ngsl12:hope.exampleChinese: 我们希望新花园能鼓励邻居们花更多时间相互交流。

ngsl12:idea.exampleEnglish: His idea for a shared tool collection could save neighbours money and reduce the amount they throw away.
ngsl12:idea.exampleChinese: 他提出共享工具的想法，既能帮邻居省钱，也能减少丢弃的物品。

ngsl12:cost.exampleEnglish: The cost of the repairs was higher than expected because several damaged parts had to be replaced.
ngsl12:cost.exampleChinese: 维修费用比预期高，因为几处损坏的零件必须更换。

ngsl12:less.exampleEnglish: The new lighting system uses less electricity while making the reading room noticeably brighter in the evening.
ngsl12:less.exampleChinese: 新照明系统耗电更少，晚间阅览室却明显更亮了。

ngsl12:room.exampleEnglish: The room at the back of the house was quiet enough to use as a small office.
ngsl12:room.exampleChinese: 房子后部的房间很安静，足以用作小办公室。

ngsl12:until.exampleEnglish: We waited until the rain stopped before leaving the café and continuing our walk along the coast.
ngsl12:until.exampleChinese: 我们等到雨停后才离开咖啡馆，继续沿海岸步行。

ngsl12:reason.exampleEnglish: The main reason for choosing this route was that it offered safe paths away from busy roads.
ngsl12:reason.exampleChinese: 选择这条路线的主要原因，是它提供了远离繁忙道路的安全小路。

ngsl12:form.exampleEnglish: The painting gradually took the form of a landscape as she added the river and distant hills.
ngsl12:form.exampleChinese: 随着她添上河流和远山，这幅画逐渐呈现出风景画的样子。

ngsl12:spend.exampleEnglish: We try to spend less on transport by walking whenever the weather and the distance allow it.
ngsl12:spend.exampleChinese: 只要天气和距离允许，我们就步行，尽量少花交通费。

ngsl12:head.exampleEnglish: Wear a helmet to protect your head when you cycle, even if you are only travelling a short distance.
ngsl12:head.exampleChinese: 骑车时请戴头盔保护头部，即使只走很短的距离。

ngsl12:car.exampleEnglish: We left the car outside the village because the narrow streets were easier to explore on foot.
ngsl12:car.exampleChinese: 我们把车停在村外，因为狭窄街道更适合步行游览。

ngsl12:learn.exampleEnglish: You can learn a great deal from other people's suggestions without agreeing with every opinion they express.
ngsl12:learn.exampleChinese: 即使不认同别人表达的每个观点，你仍能从他们的建议中学到很多。

ngsl12:level.exampleEnglish: We need to level the ground before building the shelter, otherwise the wooden floor will not fit properly.
ngsl12:level.exampleChinese: 搭棚前我们需要平整地面，否则木地板无法妥善安装。

ngsl12:person.exampleEnglish: The person responsible for the booking should check the final numbers before confirming how many tickets are needed.
ngsl12:person.exampleChinese: 负责预订的人应核对最终人数，再确认需要多少张票。

ngsl12:experience.exampleEnglish: Her experience of working with visitors helped her explain the complicated instructions in a clear and friendly way.
ngsl12:experience.exampleChinese: 她接待游客的经验，帮助她用清楚友好的方式讲解复杂说明。

ngsl12:once.exampleEnglish: I have only visited the island once, but I still remember the sound of waves outside our window.
ngsl12:once.exampleChinese: 我只去过那座岛一次，却仍记得窗外的海浪声。

ngsl12:member.exampleEnglish: Each member of the group chose a different task so that the work could be completed efficiently.
ngsl12:member.exampleChinese: 每个组员选择不同任务，使工作能够高效完成。

ngsl12:enough.exampleEnglish: We had enough food for everyone, although several extra guests arrived just before the meal began.
ngsl12:enough.exampleChinese: 虽然开饭前又来了几位客人，但食物仍足够所有人吃。

ngsl12:bad.exampleEnglish: The road was in bad condition after the winter, making the journey slower and less comfortable.
ngsl12:bad.exampleChinese: 过冬后路况很差，让旅途更慢也更不舒适。

ngsl12:city.exampleEnglish: The city has introduced more bicycle lanes to make travelling between residential areas and the centre safer.
ngsl12:city.exampleChinese: 这座城市增设了自行车道，让住宅区与市中心之间的骑行更安全。

ngsl12:night.exampleEnglish: We stayed up late that night, discussing which places we should visit during the rest of our holiday.
ngsl12:night.exampleChinese: 那天晚上我们聊到很晚，讨论假期剩下的时间该去哪些地方。

ngsl12:able.exampleEnglish: After a few lessons, she was able to repair the bicycle without needing help from her neighbour.
ngsl12:able.exampleChinese: 上过几节课后，她就能不靠邻居帮助自己修自行车了。

ngsl12:support.exampleEnglish: The library will support new readers by offering weekly sessions where they can practise with experienced volunteers.
ngsl12:support.exampleChinese: 图书馆将每周组织活动，让新读者和有经验的志愿者一起练习，为他们提供支持。

ngsl12:whether.exampleEnglish: We have not decided whether to hold the event outdoors, because the weather forecast keeps changing.
ngsl12:whether.exampleChinese: 我们还没决定是否在户外办活动，因为天气预报不断变化。

ngsl12:line.exampleEnglish: Draw a straight line between the two points before you start measuring the angle on the diagram.
ngsl12:line.exampleChinese: 先在两点之间画一条直线，再测量图上的角度。

ngsl12:present.exampleEnglish: We chose a handmade present for our neighbour because she had spent so much time helping us move.
ngsl12:present.exampleChinese: 我们为邻居选了一份手工礼物，因为她花了很多时间帮我们搬家。

ngsl12:side.exampleEnglish: Write the measurements along each side of the rectangle so that everyone can check the diagram easily.
ngsl12:side.exampleChinese: 请沿矩形各边标注尺寸，方便大家核查图示。

ngsl12:quite.exampleEnglish: The instructions were quite clear, but a practical demonstration helped everyone understand the more difficult steps.
ngsl12:quite.exampleChinese: 说明很清楚，但一次实际演示帮助大家理解了较难的步骤。

ngsl12:although.exampleEnglish: Although the room was small, careful planning allowed us to fit everything we needed along one wall.
ngsl12:although.exampleChinese: 虽然房间很小，仔细规划后我们仍把所需的一切沿一面墙放下了。

ngsl12:sure.exampleEnglish: I am sure the parcel arrived yesterday because I remember signing for it shortly before lunch.
ngsl12:sure.exampleChinese: 我确定包裹昨天到了，因为我记得午饭前不久签收了它。

ngsl12:term.exampleEnglish: The school will offer a new photography course next term if enough students express an interest.
ngsl12:term.exampleChinese: 如果足够多的学生感兴趣，学校下学期将开设一门新摄影课。

ngsl12:least.exampleEnglish: Of all the rooms we visited, the smallest one was the least expensive and surprisingly comfortable.
ngsl12:least.exampleChinese: 我们看过的所有房间中，最小的那间价格最低，而且出乎意料地舒适。

ngsl12:age.exampleEnglish: Children under the age of twelve must stay with an adult while exploring the upper floors.
ngsl12:age.exampleChinese: 十二岁以下的孩子游览楼上时，必须有成人陪同。

ngsl12:low.exampleEnglish: The low wall around the garden was easy to step over, so we added a small fence.
ngsl12:low.exampleChinese: 花园周围的矮墙很容易跨过去，所以我们又加了一道小围栏。

ngsl12:speak.exampleEnglish: Please speak slowly during the demonstration so that visitors who are learning English can follow your explanation.
ngsl12:speak.exampleChinese: 演示时请慢慢说，让正在学英语的游客能听懂你的讲解。

ngsl12:within.exampleEnglish: You should receive a reply within three working days, unless we need additional information about your request.
ngsl12:within.exampleChinese: 除非我们需要与你的请求相关的补充信息，否则你应在三个工作日内收到答复。

ngsl12:process.exampleEnglish: The office will process your application once all the necessary documents have been checked and approved.
ngsl12:process.exampleChinese: 所有必要文件核对并获批后，办公室将处理你的申请。

ngsl12:public.exampleEnglish: The council asked for public feedback before deciding whether to make permanent changes to the main square.
ngsl12:public.exampleChinese: 市政会在决定是否永久改造主广场前，征求了公众反馈。

ngsl12:often.exampleEnglish: We often discuss difficult tasks before starting, because sharing ideas can save time and prevent mistakes.
ngsl12:often.exampleChinese: 我们常在开始前讨论难题，因为分享想法能节省时间并避免错误。

ngsl12:train.exampleEnglish: We caught an earlier train so that we could visit the market before meeting our friends for lunch.
ngsl12:train.exampleChinese: 我们赶了更早的火车，以便和朋友吃午饭前先逛集市。

ngsl12:possible.exampleEnglish: It may be possible to extend the visit if everyone agrees and the building remains open late.
ngsl12:possible.exampleChinese: 如果大家同意且建筑继续开放到较晚，参观时间或许可以延长。

ngsl12:actually.exampleEnglish: I thought the museum was expensive, but admission is actually free for visitors under eighteen years old.
ngsl12:actually.exampleChinese: 我原以为博物馆很贵，但十八岁以下游客其实可以免费入场。

ngsl12:rather.exampleEnglish: The room felt rather warm after the workshop, so we opened the windows while everyone took a break.
ngsl12:rather.exampleChinese: 工作坊结束后房间有点热，于是趁大家休息时我们打开了窗户。

ngsl12:view.exampleEnglish: The view from the tower was worth the climb, even though the narrow stairs had been tiring.
ngsl12:view.exampleChinese: 尽管爬狭窄楼梯很累，塔上看到的景色还是值得一看。

ngsl12:together.exampleEnglish: We worked together to repair the old benches, sharing tools and learning useful skills from our neighbours.
ngsl12:together.exampleChinese: 我们一起修理旧长椅，共享工具，也向邻居学习实用技能。

ngsl12:consider.exampleEnglish: We should consider the needs of younger visitors before deciding how long the guided walk should last.
ngsl12:consider.exampleChinese: 决定导览步行持续多久之前，我们应该考虑年幼游客的需要。

ngsl12:price.exampleEnglish: The artist decided to price the smaller pictures reasonably so that more visitors could afford to buy them.
ngsl12:price.exampleChinese: 画家决定给小幅画作定一个合理价格，让更多游客买得起。

collocations.chinese: 为产品制定有竞争力的价格

ngsl12:parent.exampleEnglish: Every parent received a message explaining what their child should bring for the school trip next week.
ngsl12:parent.exampleChinese: 每位家长都收到了消息，说明孩子下周学校旅行应该带什么。

ngsl12:hard.exampleEnglish: The wood was too hard to cut with our small tools, so we borrowed a stronger saw.
ngsl12:hard.exampleChinese: 木头太硬，我们的小工具切不开，所以借了一把更结实的锯子。

ngsl12:party.exampleEnglish: We organised a small party for the volunteers who had helped restore the community garden over the summer.
ngsl12:party.exampleChinese: 我们为整个夏天帮助修复社区花园的志愿者办了一场小聚会。

ngsl12:local.exampleEnglish: The guide recommended a local bakery where we could buy fresh bread before starting our morning walk.
ngsl12:local.exampleChinese: 导游推荐了一家当地面包店，让我们能在晨间徒步前买新鲜面包。

ngsl12:control.exampleEnglish: The new system helps staff control the temperature in each room without wasting energy in empty areas.
ngsl12:control.exampleChinese: 新系统帮助员工控制各房间的温度，避免在空置区域浪费能源。

ngsl12:already.exampleEnglish: We had already booked our tickets when we discovered that the concert would take place outdoors.
ngsl12:already.exampleChinese: 发现音乐会将在户外举行时，我们已经订好票了。

ngsl12:concern.exampleEnglish: Her main concern was whether the children would have enough time to eat before the performance began.
ngsl12:concern.exampleChinese: 她主要担心的是孩子们在演出开始前是否有足够时间吃饭。

ngsl12:product.exampleEnglish: The shop lets customers test each product before buying, which makes choosing unfamiliar equipment much easier.
ngsl12:product.exampleChinese: 商店允许顾客购买前试用每件产品，让挑选不熟悉的设备容易多了。

ngsl12:lose.exampleEnglish: Keep the tickets in the same pocket so that you do not lose them during the journey.
ngsl12:lose.exampleChinese: 请把票放在同一个口袋里，以免途中丢失。

ngsl12:story.exampleEnglish: The guide told a story about the family who had built the house and planted its unusual garden.
ngsl12:story.exampleChinese: 导游讲述了建造这栋房子并种植独特花园的那家人的故事。

ngsl12:almost.exampleEnglish: The workshop was almost full when we arrived, but the organiser managed to find us two seats.
ngsl12:almost.exampleChinese: 我们到达时工作坊几乎满员，但组织者还是给我们找到了两个座位。

ngsl12:continue.exampleEnglish: We decided to continue the discussion after lunch because several useful suggestions still needed to be considered.
ngsl12:continue.exampleChinese: 我们决定午饭后继续讨论，因为还有几个有用建议需要考虑。

ngsl12:stand.exampleEnglish: We had to stand near the back of the hall because all the seats were already taken.
ngsl12:stand.exampleChinese: 我们不得不站在大厅后部附近，因为座位已经全满了。

ngsl12:whole.exampleEnglish: The whole village helped prepare the festival, from decorating the square to welcoming visitors at the station.
ngsl12:whole.exampleChinese: 整个村子都帮忙筹备节日，从装饰广场到在车站迎接游客。

ngsl12:yet.exampleEnglish: We have not received the final timetable yet, so we cannot confirm when the workshop will finish.
ngsl12:yet.exampleChinese: 我们还没收到最终时间表，因此无法确认工作坊何时结束。

ngsl12:rate.exampleEnglish: The rate at which the plants grew surprised everyone, especially after several weeks of cold weather.
ngsl12:rate.exampleChinese: 植物生长的速度让大家吃惊，尤其是在经历几周寒冷天气之后。

ngsl12:care.exampleEnglish: The volunteers care for the garden throughout the year, even when very few visitors come in winter.
ngsl12:care.exampleChinese: 志愿者全年照料花园，即使冬天很少有游客前来。

ngsl12:expect.exampleEnglish: We expect the repairs to finish next month, provided that all the necessary materials arrive on time.
ngsl12:expect.exampleChinese: 如果所有必要材料按时到货，我们预计维修下个月结束。

ngsl12:effect.exampleEnglish: The new lighting had an immediate effect on the room, making it feel larger and more welcoming.
ngsl12:effect.exampleChinese: 新照明立刻改变了房间，让它显得更宽敞、更亲切。

ngsl12:sort.exampleEnglish: This sort of map is particularly useful for walkers because it shows paths that ordinary road maps omit.
ngsl12:sort.exampleChinese: 这种地图对徒步者特别实用，因为它标出了普通公路地图省略的小路。

ngsl12:ever.exampleEnglish: Have you ever visited a place that looked completely different from the photographs you had seen beforehand?
ngsl12:ever.exampleChinese: 你是否到过一个地方，发现它和事先看到的照片完全不一样？

ngsl12:anything.exampleEnglish: Please ask if there is anything you do not understand before you begin using the new equipment.
ngsl12:anything.exampleChinese: 开始使用新设备前，有任何不理解的地方请提问。

ngsl12:cause.exampleEnglish: Leaving the windows open overnight could cause problems if the temperature falls below freezing before morning.
ngsl12:cause.exampleChinese: 如果天亮前气温降到冰点以下，整晚开窗可能会引发问题。

ngsl12:fall.exampleEnglish: A fall on the wet steps left him with a sore ankle, so we changed our walking plans.
ngsl12:fall.exampleChinese: 他在湿台阶上摔了一跤，脚踝疼痛，于是我们更改了徒步计划。

ngsl12:deal.exampleEnglish: Please deal the cards evenly while I explain the rules to the people who have never played before.
ngsl12:deal.exampleChinese: 我向没玩过的人解释规则时，请把牌均匀发给大家。

ngsl12:water.exampleEnglish: We carried extra water because there were no shops or public taps along the route we had chosen.
ngsl12:water.exampleChinese: 我们多带了水，因为所选路线沿途没有商店或公共水龙头。

ngsl12:send.exampleEnglish: Please send the updated timetable to everyone who registered, even if they have already received an earlier version.
ngsl12:send.exampleChinese: 请把更新的时间表发给所有报名者，即使他们已收到早期版本。

ngsl12:allow.exampleEnglish: The new arrangement will allow visitors to explore the gardens while the main building remains closed for repairs.
ngsl12:allow.exampleChinese: 新的安排将允许游客在主楼因维修关闭期间游览花园。

ngsl12:soon.exampleEnglish: The museum will reopen soon, although visitors will have to book tickets before entering the smaller galleries.
ngsl12:soon.exampleChinese: 博物馆很快重新开放，但游客进入较小展厅前需要订票。

ngsl12:watch.exampleEnglish: We stopped to watch the workers repair the roof, carefully replacing each damaged tile by hand.
ngsl12:watch.exampleChinese: 我们停下来观看工人修屋顶，他们正小心地手工替换每一块破瓦。

ngsl12:base.exampleEnglish: The old farmhouse became our base for exploring the valley because several walking routes started nearby.
ngsl12:base.exampleChinese: 老农舍成了我们探索山谷的据点，因为几条步行路线从附近开始。

ngsl12:probably.exampleEnglish: We will probably need a larger vehicle, since several people have offered to bring extra equipment.
ngsl12:probably.exampleChinese: 我们可能需要一辆更大的车，因为几个人主动提出带额外设备。

ngsl12:suggest.exampleEnglish: Could you suggest a quieter café where our group could discuss the project without disturbing other customers?
ngsl12:suggest.exampleChinese: 你能推荐一家安静些的咖啡馆，让我们讨论项目又不打扰其他顾客吗？

ngsl12:past.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explores the village's past through photographs and objects donated by families who still live nearby.
ngsl12:past.exampleChinese: 展览通过仍住在附近的家庭捐赠的照片和物品，探索村庄的过去。

ngsl12:power.exampleEnglish: The committee has the power to approve small repairs, but larger changes need permission from the council.
ngsl12:power.exampleChinese: 委员会有权批准小修，但较大的改动需要市政会许可。

ngsl12:test.exampleEnglish: The test includes practical tasks as well as written questions, allowing students to demonstrate several different skills.
ngsl12:test.exampleChinese: 这项测验既有实践任务也有书面题，让学生展示几种不同技能。

ngsl12:visit.exampleEnglish: We plan to visit the museum before lunch, when the galleries are usually less crowded and easier to explore.
ngsl12:visit.exampleChinese: 我们计划午饭前参观博物馆，那时展厅通常人少，更便于游览。

ngsl12:center.exampleEnglish: The fountain stands in the center of the square, providing a convenient meeting point for visitors.
ngsl12:center.exampleChinese: 喷泉位于广场中央，为游客提供了方便的会合地点。

ngsl12:grow.exampleEnglish: The plants grow more quickly near the window, where they receive natural light throughout the morning.
ngsl12:grow.exampleChinese: 植物在窗边长得更快，因为那里整个上午都有自然光。

ngsl12:nothing.exampleEnglish: There was nothing we could do until the replacement part arrived, so we started another task.
ngsl12:nothing.exampleChinese: 替换零件到货前我们无事可做，所以开始了另一项任务。

ngsl12:return.exampleEnglish: We agreed to return to the village next summer, when the restored gardens would be open again.
ngsl12:return.exampleChinese: 我们约定明年夏天再回村里，那时修复后的花园会重新开放。

ngsl12:mother.exampleEnglish: Her mother taught her to repair clothes, a skill that has saved the family money for years.
ngsl12:mother.exampleChinese: 她母亲教她修补衣服，这项技能多年来为家里省了钱。

ngsl12:walk.exampleEnglish: We decided to walk along the river instead of taking the bus, since the weather had improved.
ngsl12:walk.exampleChinese: 天气好转了，我们决定沿河步行，而不坐公交车。

ngsl12:matter.exampleEnglish: The missing keys were a serious matter because nobody else could open the cupboard containing the equipment.
ngsl12:matter.exampleChinese: 钥匙丢失是个严重问题，因为没有其他人能打开存放设备的橱柜。

ngsl12:mind.exampleEnglish: The workshop encouraged us to keep an open mind when listening to suggestions that challenged our usual approach.
ngsl12:mind.exampleChinese: 工作坊鼓励我们在听取挑战惯常方法的建议时保持开放心态。

ngsl12:value.exampleEnglish: An expert will value the old furniture before the family decides whether to keep it or sell it.
ngsl12:value.exampleChinese: 家里决定保留还是出售旧家具前，将由专家先估价。

ngsl12:office.exampleEnglish: The office is closed on Fridays, but staff can still answer urgent questions through the shared email account.
ngsl12:office.exampleChinese: 办公室周五关闭，但员工仍可通过共享邮箱答复紧急问题。

ngsl12:record.exampleEnglish: The team set a new record by completing the route faster than anyone had managed the previous year.
ngsl12:record.exampleChinese: 团队比上一年所有人都更快地走完路线，创下了新纪录。

ngsl12:stay.exampleEnglish: We decided to stay at a small guesthouse where the owners could recommend walks away from busy tourist areas.
ngsl12:stay.exampleChinese: 我们决定住一家小旅馆，店主能推荐远离繁忙景点的步行路线。

ngsl12:force.exampleEnglish: The strong wind could force the gate open unless we secured it with a heavier metal latch.
ngsl12:force.exampleChinese: 除非用更坚固的金属门闩锁好，否则强风可能把门强行吹开。

ngsl12:stop.exampleEnglish: We had to stop beside the road because a fallen tree was blocking the narrow entrance to the village.
ngsl12:stop.exampleChinese: 我们不得不停在路边，因为倒下的树挡住了通往村子的狭窄入口。

ngsl12:several.exampleEnglish: Several visitors asked for a longer tour because they wanted more time to examine the unusual paintings.
ngsl12:several.exampleChinese: 几位游客要求延长导览，因为他们想多花些时间仔细看那些独特画作。

ngsl12:light.exampleEnglish: The new tent is light enough to carry comfortably, even when we also need food and extra clothing.
ngsl12:light.exampleChinese: 新帐篷很轻，即使还要带食物和备用衣物，背起来也很轻松。

ngsl12:develop.exampleEnglish: Children can develop practical skills by helping with simple projects that require careful planning and teamwork.
ngsl12:develop.exampleChinese: 孩子们可以通过参与需要仔细规划和团队合作的简单项目，培养实用技能。

ngsl12:remember.exampleEnglish: Please remember where you put the spare key, because the office will be closed when we return.
ngsl12:remember.exampleChinese: 请记住备用钥匙放在哪里，因为我们回来时办公室会关门。

ngsl12:bit.exampleEnglish: There was a bit of bread left after lunch, so we saved it to make soup later.
ngsl12:bit.exampleChinese: 午饭后剩了一点面包，所以我们留着稍后做汤。

ngsl12:share.exampleEnglish: Each share gives its owner a small stake in the company, although its value can change over time.
ngsl12:share.exampleChinese: 每股股票让持有者拥有公司的一小部分权益，但股值会随时间变化。

ngsl12:real.exampleEnglish: Working on a real project helped the students understand problems that classroom exercises had never shown them.
ngsl12:real.exampleChinese: 参与真实项目，帮助学生理解了课堂练习从未呈现的问题。

ngsl12:answer.exampleEnglish: We compared our answers after the test and discovered that several questions could be understood in different ways.
ngsl12:answer.exampleChinese: 考试后我们对比答案，发现几道题可以有不同理解。

ngsl12:sit.exampleEnglish: We chose to sit near the window so that we could watch the boats while waiting for lunch.
ngsl12:sit.exampleChinese: 我们选择坐在窗边，等午饭时可以看船。

ngsl12:figure.exampleEnglish: We need to figure out why the drawer keeps sticking before we replace any of its parts.
ngsl12:figure.exampleChinese: 更换抽屉任何零件前，我们需要弄清它为何总是卡住。

ngsl12:letter.exampleEnglish: The letter explained why the delivery had been delayed and gave us a new date for its arrival.
ngsl12:letter.exampleChinese: 信中解释了投递为何延误，并告知新的到货日期。

ngsl12:decide.exampleEnglish: We should decide which tasks are most urgent before asking the volunteers to choose what they want to do.
ngsl12:decide.exampleChinese: 让志愿者选择想做的事之前，我们应该决定哪些任务最紧迫。

ngsl12:language.exampleEnglish: Learning another language can make travelling more enjoyable because everyday conversations become easier and more meaningful.
ngsl12:language.exampleChinese: 学习另一种语言能让旅行更愉快，因为日常交谈会更轻松、更有意义。

ngsl12:subject.exampleEnglish: The photographer chose the old bridge as her main subject because its shape changed with the light.
ngsl12:subject.exampleChinese: 摄影师把老桥选为主要拍摄对象，因为它的形态会随光线变化。

ngsl12:class.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explores how social class affected the homes, jobs and education available to people in the past.
ngsl12:class.exampleChinese: 展览探讨了过去社会阶层如何影响人们的住房、工作和受教育机会。

ngsl12:development.exampleEnglish: The development of new paths has made the nature reserve easier to explore without damaging sensitive areas.
ngsl12:development.exampleChinese: 新步道的建设，让人们更容易游览自然保护区，又不损害脆弱区域。

ngsl12:town.exampleEnglish: The town becomes much busier during the summer, when visitors arrive to explore the nearby lakes.
ngsl12:town.exampleChinese: 夏季游客来到附近湖区游览时，镇上会热闹得多。

ngsl12:half.exampleEnglish: Half of the group stayed to finish the painting while the others went to collect more supplies.
ngsl12:half.exampleChinese: 一半组员留下完成粉刷，其余人去领取更多用品。

ngsl12:minute.exampleEnglish: Please wait a minute while I check whether the smaller meeting room is still available this afternoon.
ngsl12:minute.exampleChinese: 请稍等一分钟，我查一下那间小会议室今天下午是否还空着。

ngsl12:food.exampleEnglish: We brought enough food for the journey because the small cafés along the route might be closed.
ngsl12:food.exampleChinese: 我们为旅程带足了食物，因为沿途小咖啡馆可能关门。

ngsl12:break.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to break the thin glass when you remove it from the wooden frame.
ngsl12:break.exampleChinese: 把薄玻璃从木框中取出时，小心不要弄碎。

ngsl12:clear.exampleEnglish: The diagram made the instructions clear, especially for people who found the written explanation difficult to follow.
ngsl12:clear.exampleChinese: 示意图让说明变得清晰，尤其帮助了那些难以理解文字解释的人。

ngsl12:future.exampleEnglish: The committee will discuss the future of the building before deciding whether to repair or replace it.
ngsl12:future.exampleChinese: 委员会将讨论这栋楼的未来用途，再决定修缮还是重建。

ngsl12:either.exampleEnglish: Either route will take us to the station, but the path beside the river is more pleasant.
ngsl12:either.exampleChinese: 两条路线都通往车站，但河边那条小路更舒适。

ngsl12:ago.exampleEnglish: We visited the island several years ago, before the new bridge made travelling there much easier.
ngsl12:ago.exampleChinese: 我们几年前去过那座岛，那时新桥还没有让交通变得更方便。

ngsl12:per.exampleEnglish: The workshop costs twenty pounds per person, including all the materials needed to complete a small project.
ngsl12:per.exampleChinese: 工作坊每人收费二十英镑，包括完成一个小项目所需的全部材料。

ngsl12:remain.exampleEnglish: Several questions remain after the presentation, so the speaker has agreed to send us additional information.
ngsl12:remain.exampleChinese: 讲解后还有几个问题没解决，因此讲者答应发给我们补充信息。

ngsl12:top.exampleEnglish: We climbed to the top of the tower, where the guide pointed out landmarks across the valley.
ngsl12:top.exampleChinese: 我们爬到塔顶，导游在那里指出山谷各处的地标。

ngsl12:among.exampleEnglish: The old cottage was hidden among tall trees, which made it difficult to find from the road.
ngsl12:among.exampleChinese: 老村舍藏在高树之间，从路上很难发现。

ngsl12:win.exampleEnglish: The team hoped to win the final match, although their opponents had played extremely well throughout the season.
ngsl12:win.exampleChinese: 球队希望赢得决赛，尽管对手整个赛季都表现极佳。

ngsl12:color.exampleEnglish: We chose a lighter color for the walls so that the narrow room would feel more spacious.
ngsl12:color.exampleChinese: 我们给墙壁选了浅一些的颜色，让狭窄房间显得更宽敞。

ngsl12:involve.exampleEnglish: The activity will involve some walking, so participants should wear comfortable shoes and bring water with them.
ngsl12:involve.exampleChinese: 活动会包含一些步行，因此参与者应穿舒适的鞋并带水。

ngsl12:reach.exampleEnglish: We should reach the village before sunset if we follow the shorter path through the woods.
ngsl12:reach.exampleChinese: 如果走穿过树林的较短路线，我们应该能在日落前到村里。

ngsl12:social.exampleEnglish: The club organises social events as well as classes, giving newcomers a chance to make local friends.
ngsl12:social.exampleChinese: 俱乐部除了开课还组织社交活动，让新来的人有机会结识本地朋友。

ngsl12:period.exampleEnglish: The garden will close for a short period while workers replace the damaged path near the entrance.
ngsl12:period.exampleChinese: 工人更换入口附近受损步道期间，花园会短暂关闭。

ngsl12:across.exampleEnglish: The children watched the ferry travel across, then waited for it to return from the opposite bank.
ngsl12:across.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着渡船驶到对岸，再等它从那边返回。

ngsl12:note.exampleEnglish: Please note that the final bus leaves earlier on Sundays, so visitors should check their return journey carefully.
ngsl12:note.exampleChinese: 请注意，周日末班车发车较早，所以游客要仔细核对返程安排。

ngsl12:history.exampleEnglish: Studying local history helped us understand why the village had grown around the river rather than the road.
ngsl12:history.exampleChinese: 研究地方历史帮助我们理解，村庄为何沿河流而非道路发展。

ngsl12:create.exampleEnglish: The workshop encourages children to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
ngsl12:create.exampleChinese: 工作坊鼓励孩子们用原本会被丢弃的材料制作实用物品。

ngsl12:drive.exampleEnglish: We decided to drive along the coast because the main road was closed for repairs that weekend.
ngsl12:drive.exampleChinese: 我们决定沿海岸开车，因为那个周末主路封闭维修。

ngsl12:along.exampleEnglish: Several benches stand along the river path, allowing walkers to stop and enjoy the view whenever they like.
ngsl12:along.exampleChinese: 河边小路沿途有几张长椅，徒步者随时可以停下欣赏风景。

ngsl12:type.exampleEnglish: This type of bicycle is suitable for city journeys, but it may be uncomfortable on rough country paths.
ngsl12:type.exampleChinese: 这种自行车适合城市出行，但在崎岖乡间小路上可能不舒适。

ngsl12:sound.exampleEnglish: The sound of water running under the bridge became louder as we approached the narrow valley.
ngsl12:sound.exampleChinese: 我们走近狭窄山谷时，桥下流水声越来越大。

ngsl12:eye.exampleEnglish: The bright sunlight hurt my eyes, so I moved into the shade before looking at the map.
ngsl12:eye.exampleChinese: 强烈阳光刺得我眼睛难受，于是我先移到阴凉处再看地图。

ngsl12:music.exampleEnglish: The festival introduced us to music from several countries that we had never heard performed live before.
ngsl12:music.exampleChinese: 音乐节让我们接触到几个国家的音乐，此前从没听过这些音乐的现场演出。

ngsl12:game.exampleEnglish: The game encouraged children to share information because no single player had all the clues needed to finish.
ngsl12:game.exampleChinese: 这款游戏鼓励孩子们共享信息，因为没有谁独自掌握完成游戏所需的全部线索。

ngsl12:political.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how political decisions changed the town's buildings and influenced the lives of ordinary residents.
ngsl12:political.exampleChinese: 展览解释了政治决策如何改变镇上的建筑，并影响普通居民的生活。

ngsl12:free.exampleEnglish: Admission is free on the first Sunday of each month, although visitors still need to reserve tickets online.
ngsl12:free.exampleChinese: 每月第一个周日免费入场，但游客仍需网上预约门票。

ngsl12:receive.exampleEnglish: You should receive a confirmation message shortly after booking, so please check that your email address is correct.
ngsl12:receive.exampleChinese: 预订后不久你应该会收到确认消息，因此请检查邮箱地址是否正确。

ngsl12:moment.exampleEnglish: For a moment, everyone stopped talking and listened to the unusual sound coming from the old clock.
ngsl12:moment.exampleChinese: 有那么一瞬间，大家停止交谈，听着老钟发出的奇怪声音。

ngsl12:sale.exampleEnglish: The sale of handmade postcards helped raise enough money to buy new materials for the children's workshop.
ngsl12:sale.exampleChinese: 销售手工明信片筹到了足够资金，为儿童工作坊购买新材料。

ngsl12:policy.exampleEnglish: The museum changed its booking policy after visitors said they needed more flexibility when planning family trips.
ngsl12:policy.exampleChinese: 游客表示安排家庭出游需要更大灵活性后，博物馆更改了预订政策。

ngsl12:further.exampleEnglish: We need further information about the route before deciding whether it is suitable for younger children.
ngsl12:further.exampleChinese: 决定路线是否适合年幼孩子之前，我们需要更多相关信息。

ngsl12:body.exampleEnglish: Stretching after a long journey can help your body feel more comfortable before you begin walking again.
ngsl12:body.exampleChinese: 长途旅行后伸展一下身体，能让你再次步行前舒服一些。

ngsl12:require.exampleEnglish: The practical workshop will require comfortable shoes because participants spend much of the session standing and moving around.
ngsl12:require.exampleChinese: 实践工作坊要求穿舒适的鞋，因为参与者大部分时间要站着和走动。

ngsl12:wait.exampleEnglish: We decided to wait inside the café until the guide arrived, rather than stand outside in the rain.
ngsl12:wait.exampleChinese: 我们决定在咖啡馆里等导游，而不站在外面淋雨。

ngsl12:general.exampleEnglish: The first part of the course provides general advice before later sessions focus on more specific practical tasks.
ngsl12:general.exampleChinese: 课程第一部分提供一般性建议，后面的课再集中讲更具体的实践任务。

ngsl12:appear.exampleEnglish: Small flowers begin to appear beside the path in spring, even before the trees have grown new leaves.
ngsl12:appear.exampleChinese: 春天树木尚未长出新叶时，小花就开始出现在路旁。

ngsl12:toward.exampleEnglish: We walked toward the harbour, where the guide had arranged for us to visit a fishing boat.
ngsl12:toward.exampleChinese: 我们朝港口走去，导游已安排我们在那里参观一艘渔船。

ngsl12:team.exampleEnglish: Our team includes people with different skills, which helps us solve practical problems from several different angles.
ngsl12:team.exampleChinese: 我们团队成员各有所长，帮助我们从多个角度解决实际问题。

ngsl12:easy.exampleEnglish: The route looks easy on the map, but several steep sections can be tiring for inexperienced walkers.
ngsl12:easy.exampleChinese: 地图上这条路线看似容易，但几段陡坡会让经验不足的徒步者很累。

ngsl12:individual.exampleEnglish: Each individual in the group received a separate task before everyone came together to discuss their results.
ngsl12:individual.exampleChinese: 组里每个人先分到一项独立任务，然后大家聚在一起讨论结果。

ngsl12:full.exampleEnglish: The bus was already full when it reached our stop, so we had to wait for the next one.
ngsl12:full.exampleChinese: 公交车到我们这站时已经满了，所以我们只能等下一班。

ngsl12:black.exampleEnglish: The black cover protected the equipment from sunlight while making it harder to spot against the dark wall.
ngsl12:black.exampleChinese: 黑色外罩让设备避开阳光，但靠着深色墙壁时也更难被发现。

ngsl12:sense.exampleEnglish: She could sense a change in the atmosphere when the conversation moved from travel plans to family problems.
ngsl12:sense.exampleChinese: 话题从旅行计划转到家庭问题时，她能感觉到气氛变了。

ngsl12:perhaps.exampleEnglish: Perhaps we should contact the museum before leaving, because its opening hours sometimes change during the holidays.
ngsl12:perhaps.exampleChinese: 也许出发前该联系博物馆，因为它的开放时间在假期有时会变。

ngsl12:add.exampleEnglish: Please add the dates to the shared calendar so that everyone knows when the equipment will be unavailable.
ngsl12:add.exampleChinese: 请把日期加进共享日历，让大家知道设备何时不可使用。

ngsl12:rule.exampleEnglish: The main rule is that visitors must stay on the path to avoid damaging the plants nearby.
ngsl12:rule.exampleChinese: 主要规定是游客必须沿步道行走，以免损伤附近植物。

ngsl12:pass.exampleEnglish: We will pass the old watermill on our way to the village, so there will be time for photographs.
ngsl12:pass.exampleChinese: 去村里的路上我们会经过老水磨坊，因此会有时间拍照。

ngsl12:produce.exampleEnglish: The factory can produce smaller batches, which allows local businesses to order only what they really need.
ngsl12:produce.exampleChinese: 工厂能小批量生产，让当地企业只订购真正需要的数量。

ngsl12:sell.exampleEnglish: The village shop plans to sell more locally made products so that visitors can support nearby businesses.
ngsl12:sell.exampleChinese: 村里的商店计划销售更多本地产品，让游客支持附近企业。

ngsl12:short.exampleEnglish: We chose the short route through the park because the children were tired after visiting the museum.
ngsl12:short.exampleChinese: 参观博物馆后孩子们累了，所以我们选了穿过公园的短路线。

ngsl12:agree.exampleEnglish: We agree that the garden needs more seating, but we have different ideas about where to put it.
ngsl12:agree.exampleChinese: 我们都认为花园需要更多座位，但对摆放位置有不同想法。

ngsl12:law.exampleEnglish: The new law requires businesses to provide clearer information about the cost of cancelling a booking.
ngsl12:law.exampleChinese: 新法律要求企业更清楚地说明取消预订的费用。

ngsl12:everything.exampleEnglish: Before leaving the workshop, please check that everything you borrowed has been returned to the correct cupboard.
ngsl12:everything.exampleChinese: 离开工作坊前，请检查借用的所有东西是否都已放回正确的橱柜。

ngsl12:research.exampleEnglish: The students will research the history of the bridge before designing an exhibition about its importance to the village.
ngsl12:research.exampleChinese: 学生们将研究桥的历史，再设计展览说明它对村庄的重要性。

ngsl12:cover.exampleEnglish: The waterproof cover kept our bags dry even when heavy rain started during the walk back.
ngsl12:cover.exampleChinese: 即使返程徒步时下起大雨，防水罩也让我们的包保持干燥。

ngsl12:paper.exampleEnglish: We used recycled paper for the invitations because the event was intended to encourage more environmentally responsible choices.
ngsl12:paper.exampleChinese: 我们用再生纸制作邀请函，因为活动旨在鼓励更环保的选择。

ngsl12:position.exampleEnglish: The position of the table near the window made it easier to examine the small objects carefully.
ngsl12:position.exampleChinese: 桌子靠窗的位置让人更容易仔细观察小物件。

ngsl12:near.exampleEnglish: The near end of the platform was crowded, but there was plenty of space beside the last carriage.
ngsl12:near.exampleChinese: 站台近端很拥挤，但最后一节车厢旁有很多空间。

ngsl12:human.exampleEnglish: Every human needs opportunities to rest, especially after spending a long time concentrating on difficult tasks.
ngsl12:human.exampleChinese: 每个人都需要休息机会，尤其是在长时间专注于困难任务后。

ngsl12:computer.exampleEnglish: The computer stores our bookings in one place, making it easier to find details when visitors call.
ngsl12:computer.exampleChinese: 电脑集中储存预订记录，方便游客来电时查找详情。

ngsl12:situation.exampleEnglish: The situation improved once we agreed on a clear plan and made sure everyone understood their responsibilities.
ngsl12:situation.exampleChinese: 我们确定清晰计划，并确保每个人理解职责后，情况就改善了。
